dct_description_sm: This project aimed at: 1) to provide quantitative information on the species composition, distribution, and abundance of benthic invertebrates and macroalgae in representative intertidal and subtidal habitats; 2) to compare subtidal communities in several representative nearshore habitats at locations varying in degree of exposure; 3) to identify, if possible, patterns of distribution of subtidal communities.
dct_title_s: Benthic fauna and macroalgae in coastal areas of Southeast Baffin Island
